cases.question: Which knowledge-base pages should an agent read at session start?
cases.expected_answer: Read docs/wiki/index.md, docs/wiki/README.md, docs/wiki/steering/agent-bootstrap-rules.md, and docs/wiki/steering/session-workflow.md at session start; consult other pages only when needed.

cases.question: What should an agent do before fixing an unclear or silent failure?
cases.expected_answer: Gather logs, test output, and direct observations before proposing a fix; then prefer a small, reversible fix based on verified evidence.

expected_evidence.text: Gather logs, test output, and direct observations

cases.question: What should be investigated first when the ansible_lint workflow fails?
cases.expected_answer: Inspect the unittest step output first because helper tests run before ansible-lint; investigate lint findings only after those tests pass.

expected_evidence.text: Runs hook behavior tests before linting.
inspect the unittest step output in Actions logs

cases.question: When should a role be excluded from GitHub Actions?
cases.expected_answer: Flag the conflicting guidance: AGENTS.md says roles requiring elevated privileges or system-service interaction must be guarded, while the wiki says guard only genuine CI incompatibilities and attempt CI first. Do not present either as the sole settled rule; resolve the conflict or ask for clarification.

expected_evidence.text: Roles that require elevated privileges, interact with system-level services
attempt a CI run before excluding the role

cases.question: Which Slack package source does the workstation configuration use, and why is its key trusted?
cases.expected_answer: Slack is installed from the packagecloud APT repository using the debian/jessie suite. The vendored public key is trusted only after validating its pinned full fingerprint and preserving clear provenance.

expected_evidence.text: full fingerprint is pinned and validated
